description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Kiribathkumbura village. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
